name: Dwarven Spider

abilities.name: Shocking Touch
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that does minor shock damage.

abilities.name: Double Strike
abilities.description: A charged melee attack that does moderate physical damage twice. This attack can be blocked to set the spider off balance and makes it only hit once.

abilities.name: Static Field
abilities.description: The spider charges up, emitting a shock aura around itself. Standing in it deals continuous shock damage over time to all targets as indicated by a red circle. Other Dwarven automatons may also attempt to charge up by being near the spider, although this can be interrupted. When an automaton is charged, it glows blue and deals more damage.

abilities.name: Overcharge
abilities.description: If the spider is destroyed while charged, an explosion occurs, dealing moderate shock damage to all targets around it as indicated by a red circle.

notes: There are several Dwarven Spider pets available for acquisition, including Dwarven Spider, Razak's Opus, Icebound Dwarven Spider, Pedlar Pack Spider, Solar Arc Dwarven Spider, Infernium Dwarven Spiderling, and Energetic Dwarven Shock-Spider.

There are also Dwarven Spider mounts: the Dwarven Spider, Baandari Dwarven Spider, Chroma-Blue Dwarven Spider, Coral Crawler Dwarven Spider, Duo-Dynamo Argent Spider, Duo-Dynamo Burnished Spider, Duo-Dynamo Dwarven Spider, Ebon Steel Dwarven Spider, Ebony Dwarven Spider, Frost Atronach Dwarven Spider, and Infernium Dwarven Spider.
Dwarven Spiders in Rkundzelft look like and act like Swarming Dwarven Spiders.

summary: This article is about the creature. For the mount, see Dwarven Spider (mount). Dwarven Spiders are hostile, spider-like Dwarven automatons that can be found in Dwemer ruins. They can be encountered individually as well as in swarms.
